author: NOWIFE
text_post: I have been in a 11 year long custody battle with my ex wife. I have lost every round! To include the time my daughter and ex were living with a drug dealer who had a drive by shooting at his house while my daughter was home. Oh and the bullet went into her room! Still was told to pay more child support and that my calling twice a week to talk to her was too disruptive to the child’s “family life”. Geographical force restriction is a joke. The EX has moved all over the country for 11 years and never been forced to move back! Every time I bring up the subject of how men are treated in the legal system, I am met with resistance and told that woman have it much worse in life and I should suck it up. There are very few logical thinkers out there in the mainstream that can relate or even be empathetic to us! All I can say is we have to fulfill our financial obligation and when child gets older, we can begin to build a stronger relationship. There is no way to win without a logical judge on your side. 98% of them are are women and blue pill manginas.
